name: comp-125

frames.best_why: Thumbnail, Change image button, filename and Remove link are all visible with no cursor overlap.

tagline: Pick one image, see a thumbnail, then change or remove it.
summary: A small avatar-style uploader: an outline square placeholder and an Upload image button. Choosing a file fills the square with a preview, relabels the button and reveals the filename and a Remove link.
appearance: A small dark rounded square holding a faint user glyph sits beside a light rounded Upload image button on a near-black stage. After a pick, the square becomes a blue gradient thumbnail, the button reads Change image, and a grey filename with a red Remove link appears below.
behaviour: Clicking the button opens the file picker; on selection the placeholder swaps for the image, the button changes its label and the filename plus Remove link appear. Remove clears everything back to the placeholder.
demo_content: The filename "cover-1.png", the labels Upload image and Change image, and the "Basic image uploader" credit.
use_when: A profile or settings form needs one image with a thumbnail, a change action and an easy remove.
avoid_when: It takes a single image with no size or type guidance and needs the file-upload hook copied alongside it.
customise: No props: the accepted type, the button labels and the credit link are fixed, so different rules or wording mean editing the file.
weight_why: One button, a small preview square and a hidden file input.

a11y.note: Preview, file input and Remove are labelled and the filename is announced; the placeholder glyph is hidden as decoration.

polish_why: Clear empty and filled states with an obvious remove action; a demo credit line sits in the flow.
